s0201.literal: The Yellow River broke through at fifteen places—Kaifeng, Xiangfu, Chenliu, Qi, Taikang, Tongxu, Yanling, Fugou, Weichuan, Weishi, Yangwu, Yanjin, Zhongmou, Yuanwu, and Suizhou; 204,323 laborers from the Southern Capital were mobilized to build dikes in sections.
s0201.idiomatic: The Yellow River broke through at fifteen places—Kaifeng, Xiangfu, Chenliu, Qi, Taikang, Tongxu, Yanling, Fugou, Weichuan, Weishi, Yangwu, Yanjin, Zhongmou, Yuanwu, and Suizhou—and 204,323 laborers from the Southern Capital were mobilized to build dikes in sections.

s0202.literal: On guichou day an edict ordered the military officers under each Jiangnan province to train naval forces.
s0202.idiomatic: On guichou day an edict ordered military officers under each Jiangnan province to train naval forces.

s0203.literal: One thousand newly submitted guard troops were dispatched to garrison-farm at Bieshiba Li; a marshal command was established on the spot to oversee them.
s0203.idiomatic: One thousand newly submitted guard troops were sent to garrison-farm at Bieshiba Li, and a marshal command was established on the spot to oversee them.

s0204.literal: On jiayin day Venus transgressed Jinxian.
s0204.idiomatic: On jiayin day Venus transgressed Jinxian.

s0205.literal: For merit in the Burma campaign, pacification envoy Zhang Wan was transferred to deputy chief commander for the Burma campaign, Yeshi Tiemuer to darughachi of the Burma pacification commission, and chiliarch Zhang Cheng to Burma pacification envoy, all with tiger tallies; an edict ordered war ships built and six thousand troops led to campaign against Burma, with Tudmandai as chief commander to oversee all.
s0205.idiomatic: For merit in the Burma campaign, pacification envoy Zhang Wan was made deputy chief commander for the Burma campaign, Yeshi Tiemuer darughachi of the Burma pacification commission, and chiliarch Zhang Cheng Burma pacification envoy, all with tiger tallies; an edict ordered war ships built and 6,000 troops led against Burma under chief commander Tudmandai.

s0206.literal: On yimao day Prince Tuohuan was given four thousand horses and three horses per dependent household.
s0206.idiomatic: On yimao day Prince Tuohuan was given 4,000 horses and three horses per dependent household.

s0207.literal: On gengshen day Jining Circuit presented two stalks of ganoderma.
s0207.idiomatic: On gengshen day Jining Circuit presented two stalks of ganoderma.

s0208.literal: On renxu day the Hejian salt transport bureau was changed to a general transport commission.
s0208.idiomatic: On renxu day the Hejian salt transport bureau was changed to a general transport commission.

s0209.literal: One thousand newly submitted garrison troops of Ganzhou were moved to garrison-farm at Zhongxing, and one thousand to garrison-farm at Yilihei.
s0209.idiomatic: One thousand newly submitted Ganzhou garrison troops were moved to garrison-farm at Zhongxing, and 1,000 to garrison-farm at Yilihei.

s0210.literal: Goryeo sent envoys presenting sixteen Japanese captives.
s0210.idiomatic: Goryeo sent envoys presenting 16 Japanese captives.

s0211.literal: Ma-Fa sent saddles and harness and felt armor.
s0211.idiomatic: Ma-Fa sent saddles and harness and felt armor.

s0212.literal: In Xianyou County, Xinghua Circuit, insects damaged the grain crop.
s0212.idiomatic: In Xianyou County, Xinghua Circuit, insects damaged the grain crop.

s0213.literal: Eleventh month, yichou day, Central Secretariat officials said: "Zhu Qing and others transporting grain by sea route—over four years the total was 1,010,000 shi; for bushel-and-dipper losses and spoilage we wish to make full restitution; for boats capsized by wind and waves we ask exemption from levy.
s0213.idiomatic: Eleventh month, yichou day, Central Secretariat officials said, "Zhu Qing and others transporting grain by sea route—over four years the total was 1,010,000 shi; for bushel-and-dipper losses and spoilage we wish to make full restitution, and for boats capsized by wind and waves we ask exemption from levy.

s0215.literal: Then Pacifier-General Zhang Xuan, coastal pacification envoy, and Bright Authority General Zhu Qing, army commander in chief of ten thousand households also managing sea-route grain transport ships, were both made commanders in chief of ten thousand households for sea-route grain transport, still bearing tiger tallies.
s0215.idiomatic: Pacifier-General Zhang Xuan, coastal pacification envoy, and Bright Authority General Zhu Qing, army commander in chief of ten thousand households also managing sea-route grain transport ships, were both made sea-route grain transport commanders in chief of ten thousand households, still bearing tiger tallies.

s0216.literal: An edict forbade hunting while beasts and birds were breeding.
s0216.idiomatic: An edict forbade hunting while beasts and birds were breeding.

s0217.literal: On wuchen day Venus transgressed Kang.
s0217.idiomatic: On wuchen day Venus transgressed Kang.

s0218.literal: Mongol chiliarch Quchu and others were dispatched to command four hundred newly submitted troops garrison-farming at Bieshiba Li.
s0218.idiomatic: Mongol chiliarch Quchu and others were dispatched to command 400 newly submitted troops garrison-farming at Bieshiba Li.

s0219.literal: On jisi day Siming and three other prefectures were all changed to circuits.
s0219.idiomatic: On jisi day Siming and three other prefectures were all changed to circuits.

s0220.literal: Abachi was appointed right associate of the Champa campaign branch secretariat.
s0220.idiomatic: Abachi was appointed right associate of the Champa campaign branch secretariat.

s0221.literal: On bingzi day, because Liangxiang and Baodi counties in Zhuo and Yi prefectures suffered famine, this year's land tax was remitted and three months' grain issued.
s0221.idiomatic: On bingzi day, because Liangxiang and Baodi counties in Zhuo and Yi prefectures suffered famine, this year's land tax was remitted and three months' grain issued.

s0222.literal: Pingluan, Taiyuan, and Bianliang suffered flood and drought disasters; 25,600-odd shi of civilian land tax was remitted.
s0222.idiomatic: Pingluan, Taiyuan, and Bianliang suffered flood and drought disasters, and 25,600-odd shi of civilian land tax was remitted.

s0223.literal: The Guangdong transport maritime trade intendant bureau was changed to the salt levy maritime trade intendant bureau.
s0223.idiomatic: The Guangdong transport maritime trade intendant bureau was changed to the salt levy maritime trade intendant bureau.

s0224.literal: On dingchou day Tachar and Hunan were ordered to proceed to Arhun.
s0224.idiomatic: On dingchou day Tachar and Hunan were ordered to proceed to Arhun.

s0225.literal: On wuyin day envoys were dispatched to verify famine victims in Xuanning County and provide relief.
s0225.idiomatic: On wuyin day envoys were sent to verify famine victims in Xuanning County and provide relief.

s0226.literal: On jimao day the moon transgressed the Well.
s0226.idiomatic: On jimao day the moon transgressed the Well.

s0227.literal: On xinsi day Jupiter transgressed Leibi Formation.
s0227.idiomatic: On xinsi day Jupiter transgressed Leibi Formation.

s0228.literal: Twelfth month, yiwei day: Kaiyuan in Liaodong suffered famine; grain was distributed for three months.
s0228.idiomatic: Twelfth month, yiwei day: Kaiyuan in Liaodong suffered famine, and grain was distributed for three months.

s0229.literal: On wuxu day Venus transgressed Dongxian.
s0229.idiomatic: On wuxu day Venus transgressed Dongxian.

s0230.literal: On guimao day Yeshi Mu registered the household property of Ali Haiya and had it transported to the capital.
s0230.idiomatic: On guimao day Yeshi Mu registered Ali Haiya's household property and had it transported to the capital.

s0231.literal: Prince Shibo's five thousand troops were given fifteen thousand liang of silver and three thousand ingots of notes; two thousand tammaq were given seventy thousand sheep.
s0231.idiomatic: Prince Shibo's 5,000 troops were given 15,000 liang of silver and 3,000 ingots of notes; 2,000 tammaq were given 70,000 sheep.

s0232.literal: On bingwu day pacification commissions for the three circuits of Yannan, Hedong, and Shandong were established.
s0232.idiomatic: On bingwu day pacification commissions for the three circuits of Yannan, Hedong, and Shandong were established.

s0234.literal: On dingwei day the moon transgressed the Well.
s0234.idiomatic: On dingwei day the moon transgressed the Well.

s0235.literal: On yimao day: for pacification commissions in each circuit, four posts were established in the interior and six in Jiangnan.
s0235.idiomatic: On yimao day, for pacification commissions in each circuit, four posts were established in the interior and six in Jiangnan.

s0236.literal: One thousand fugitive commoners without masters sheltered by Ali Haiya were put to garrison-farming.
s0236.idiomatic: One thousand masterless fugitive commoners sheltered by Ali Haiya were put to garrison-farming.

s0237.literal: Central Secretariat judicial official Tubushen was dispatched again to audit money and grain of the Huguang branch secretariat.
s0237.idiomatic: Central Secretariat judicial official Tubushen was dispatched again to audit money and grain of the Huguang branch secretariat.

s0238.literal: The Quanzhou maritime trade intendant bureau was reestablished.
s0238.idiomatic: The Quanzhou maritime trade intendant bureau was reestablished.

s0239.literal: The capital suffered famine; official grain was sold at reduced price to the poor.
s0239.idiomatic: The capital suffered famine; official grain was sold at reduced price to the poor.

s0240.literal: On bingchen day poor Puchang clients were sent to reclaim idle land in Gansu; the government provided oxen, seed, and farm implements.
s0240.idiomatic: On bingchen day poor Puchang clients were sent to reclaim idle land in Gansu; the government provided oxen, seed, and farm implements.

s0241.literal: King Chen Yiji of Annam was given sheep, horses, and one hundred ingots of notes.
s0241.idiomatic: King Chen Yiji of Annam was given sheep, horses, and 100 ingots of notes.

s0242.literal: On dingsi day the moon transgressed Di.
s0242.idiomatic: On dingsi day the moon transgressed Di.

s0243.literal: On wuwu day Hanlin academician Sariman said: "The Dynastic History Academy is compiling veritable records of successive reigns from Taizu; we ask to translate them into Uighur script and only then finalize after presentation and reading.
s0243.idiomatic: On wuwu day Hanlin academician Sariman said, "The dynastic history academy is compiling veritable records of successive reigns from Taizu; we ask to translate them into Uighur script and only then finalize after presentation and reading.

s0245.literal: Each circuit was divided to establish six agricultural encouragement commissions.
s0245.idiomatic: Each circuit was divided to establish six agricultural encouragement commissions.

s0246.literal: On gengshen day the Precious Tribute Bureau was established in Jining and other circuits, rank 5b.
s0246.idiomatic: On gengshen day the precious tribute bureau was established in Jining and other circuits, rank 5b.

s0247.literal: That year Yeshi Silinzhen was appointed Imperial Preceptor.
s0247.idiomatic: That year Yeshi Silinzhen was appointed imperial preceptor.

s0248.literal: Princes Aoluchi, Tuohuan, Shibo, Yebogan, and others were given 151,923 ingots of notes for sheep and horses, 7,290 horses, 36,269 sheep, 3,288 bolts of silk, felt, and cotton cloth, and fourteen sable furs.
s0248.idiomatic: Princes Aoluchi, Tuohuan, Shibo, Yebogan, and others were given 151,923 ingots of notes for sheep and horses, 7,290 horses, 36,269 sheep, 3,288 bolts of silk, felt, and cotton cloth, and 14 sable furs.

s0249.literal: Prince Tuohuan's dependent Lianyasibuhua and others and craftsmen of various bureaus in Qian Prefecture were also given 56,139 ingots and twelve liang of notes.
s0249.idiomatic: Prince Tuohuan's dependent Lianyasibuhua and others and craftsmen of various bureaus in Qian Prefecture were also given 56,139 ingots and 12 liang of notes.

s0250.literal: Western monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites in succession at Wanshou Mountain, Jade Pagoda Hall, and Wan'an Monastery, thirty sessions in all.
s0250.idiomatic: Western monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites in succession at Wanshou Mountain, Jade Pagoda Hall, and Wan'an Monastery, 30 sessions in all.

s0251.literal: The Grand Secretariat for Agriculture reported 20,166 schools in all circuits, 90,535 shi of stored charity grain, and 23,094,672 mulberry, jujube, and various fruit trees planted.
s0251.idiomatic: The grand secretariat for agriculture reported 20,166 schools in all circuits, 90,535 shi of stored charity grain, and 23,094,672 mulberry, jujube, and various fruit trees planted.

s0252.literal: One hundred fourteen persons were sentenced to death.

s0253.literal: Twenty-fourth year, spring, first month, yichou day: Shiliang County in Yunnan was restored.
s0253.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, on yichou day of the first month of spring, Shiliang County in Yunnan was restored.

s0254.literal: On wuchen day three thousand southern troops were used to build dikes on the Liulin River and dredge the canal at Hexiwu.
s0254.idiomatic: On wuchen day 3,000 southern troops were used to build dikes on the Liulin River and dredge the canal at Hexiwu.

s0255.literal: Prince Aoluchi's dependent households suffered famine; Datong Circuit was ordered to provide sixty days' grain.
s0255.idiomatic: Prince Aoluchi's dependent households suffered famine; Datong Circuit was ordered to provide 60 days' grain.

s0256.literal: Labor and tax levies on original registers in the Tangut guard's Hexi territory were remitted.
s0256.idiomatic: Labor and tax levies on original registers in the Tangut guard's Hexi territory were remitted.

s0257.literal: On renshen day the Emperor received New Year's congratulations from princes and officials in the main hall.
s0257.idiomatic: On renshen day the Emperor received New Year's congratulations from princes and officials in the main hall.

s0258.literal: On guiyou day envoys Buliu Wennai and others from Kulang came to court.
s0258.idiomatic: On guiyou day envoys Buliu Wennai and others from Kulang came to court.

s0259.literal: On jiaxu day the moon transgressed the Eastern Well.
s0259.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the moon transgressed the Eastern Well.

s0260.literal: On yiyou day the moon transgressed Fang.
s0260.idiomatic: On yiyou day the moon transgressed Fang.

s0261.literal: On bingxu day Associate Administrator Cheng Pengfei was made right councillor of the Central Secretariat and Ali left councillor.
s0261.idiomatic: On bingxu day associate administrator Cheng Pengfei was made right councillor of the central secretariat and Ali left councillor.

s0262.literal: On dinghai day Buyan Lihaiya was made associate administrator.
s0262.idiomatic: On dinghai day Buyan Lihaiya was made associate administrator.

s0263.literal: One thousand newly submitted troops were dispatched to follow Abachi against Annam.
s0263.idiomatic: One thousand newly submitted troops were dispatched to follow Abachi against Annam.

s0264.literal: The ban on bows and arrows in Jurchen and Shui Dada territory was lifted.
s0264.idiomatic: The ban on bows and arrows in Jurchen and Shui Dada territory was lifted.

s0265.literal: The Jiang-Zhe province was again changed to the Jianghuai branch secretariat.
s0265.idiomatic: The Jiang-Zhe province was again changed to the Jianghuai branch secretariat.

s0266.literal: On wuzi day ten thousand ingots of notes were used to relieve the poor of Woduan.
s0266.idiomatic: On wuzi day 10,000 ingots of notes were used to relieve the poor of Woduan.

s0267.literal: The western frontier suffered famine that year and the people were distressed; ten thousand bolts of silk were granted.
s0267.idiomatic: The western frontier suffered famine that year and the people were distressed; 10,000 bolts of silk were granted.

s0268.literal: On gengyin day envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the Sacred Peaks and Streams, Earth Altar, and Eastern Sea on the Emperor's behalf.
s0268.idiomatic: On gengyin day envoys were sent to sacrifice at the Sacred Peaks and Streams, Earth Altar, and Eastern Sea in the Emperor's stead.

s0269.literal: On xinmao day the surveillance commissions of Huaidong, Huaixi, and Shannan circuits were placed under the mobile censorate.
s0269.idiomatic: On xinmao day the surveillance commissions of Huaidong, Huaixi, and Shannan circuits were placed under the mobile censorate.

s0270.literal: The Upper Forest Bureau was established, rank 7b.
s0270.idiomatic: The upper forest bureau was established, rank 7b.

s0271.literal: An edict ordered Mongol and Han coupon-army troops of Jianghuai, Jiangxi, and Huguang provinces and Yunnan troops, plus Li troops of the four overseas prefectures, mobilized; sea-route grain transport commander Zhang Wenhu and others were ordered to transport 170,000 shi of grain and campaign against Champa by separate routes.
s0271.idiomatic: An edict ordered Mongol and Han coupon-army troops of Jianghuai, Jiangxi, and Huguang provinces and Yunnan troops, plus Li troops of the four overseas prefectures, mobilized; sea-route grain transport commander Zhang Wenhu and others were ordered to transport 170,000 shi of grain and campaign against Champa by separate routes.

s0272.literal: The Champa campaign branch secretariat was established with Aoluchi as grand councillor, Umar and Fan Ji as associate administrators to oversee all, all under Prince Zhennan's command.
s0272.idiomatic: The Champa campaign branch secretariat was established with Aoluchi as grand councillor, Umar and Fan Ji as associate administrators to oversee all, all under Prince Zhennan's command.

s0273.literal: Second month, renchen new moon: envoys were sent with incense and silks to perform rituals at Longhu, Gezao, and Sanmao, summoning Celestial Master Zhang Zongyan to court.
s0273.idiomatic: Second month, renchen new moon: envoys were sent with incense and silks to perform rituals at Longhu, Gezao, and Sanmao, summoning Celestial Master Zhang Zongyan to court.

s0274.literal: On guisi day the Yonggu tribe suffered famine; four thousand shi of rice were distributed; when insufficient, the cash equivalent of six thousand shi was also granted.
s0274.idiomatic: On guisi day the Yonggu tribe suffered famine; 4,000 shi of rice were distributed, and when that proved insufficient the cash equivalent of 6,000 shi was also granted.

s0275.literal: On jiawu day the Emperor hunted in the near suburbs.
s0275.idiomatic: On jiawu day the Emperor hunted in the near suburbs.

s0276.literal: On yiwei day Maishuding was made grand councillor.
s0276.idiomatic: On yiwei day Maishuding was made grand councillor.

s0277.literal: Zhending Circuit suffered famine; grain from riverside granaries was sold at reduced price.
s0277.idiomatic: Zhending Circuit suffered famine; grain from riverside granaries was sold at reduced price.

s0278.literal: More than forty thousand government horses pastured at Zhending were distributed to other prefectures for pasturing.
s0278.idiomatic: More than 40,000 government horses pastured at Zhending were distributed to other prefectures for pasturing.

s0279.literal: Hunting was forbidden in Uighur territory while beasts and birds were breeding.
s0279.idiomatic: Hunting was forbidden in Uighur territory while beasts and birds were breeding.

s0280.literal: On gengzi day the moon transgressed Tianguan.
s0280.idiomatic: On gengzi day the moon transgressed Tianguan.

s0281.literal: On xinchou day the moon transgressed the Eastern Well.
s0281.idiomatic: On xinchou day the moon transgressed the Eastern Well.

s0282.literal: On jiachen day the Jianghuai branch grand secretariat for agriculture was raised to rank 2; six agricultural encouragement and garrison-farming commissions, rank 4, each with two commissioners and two vice commissioners, were established under it.
s0282.idiomatic: On jiachen day the Jianghuai branch grand secretariat for agriculture was raised to rank 2; six agricultural encouragement and garrison-farming commissions, rank 4, each with two commissioners and two vice commissioners, were established under it.

s0283.literal: Fan Wenhu was made right councillor of the Central Secretariat and consulted on Privy Council affairs.
s0283.idiomatic: Fan Wenhu was made right councillor of the central secretariat and consulted on privy council affairs.

s0284.literal: On renzi day imperial son-in-law Changji was enfeoffed as Prince of Ningpu Commandery.
s0284.idiomatic: On renzi day imperial son-in-law Changji was enfeoffed as Prince of Ningpu Commandery.

s0285.literal: A metropolitan general administration commission was established to oversee the Northern Pacification Prince's artisans and large and small revenues of Woduan.
s0285.idiomatic: A metropolitan general administration commission was established to oversee the Northern Pacification Prince's artisans and large and small revenues of Woduan.

s0286.literal: Central Secretariat officials said: "From New Year's to mid-second month five hundred thousand ingots of notes were spent; we jointly oversee revenues; from now on when attendants memorialize requesting grants, we ask to be allowed to deliberate first.
s0286.idiomatic: Central Secretariat officials said, "From New Year's to mid-second month 500,000 ingots of notes were spent; we jointly oversee revenues; from now on when attendants memorialize requesting grants, we ask to be allowed to deliberate first.

s0287.literal: " The Emperor said: "This is what I always worry about.
s0287.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "This is what I always worry about.

s0288.literal: " He also instructed Yisutiemuer and Yuechiche to be informed.
s0288.idiomatic: " He also instructed Yisutiemuer and Yuechiche to be informed.

s0289.literal: On bingchen day Ma Ba'er sent tribute goods.
s0289.idiomatic: On bingchen day Ma Ba'er sent tribute goods.

s0290.literal: On wuwu day an edict ordered Prince Chalithemur to command all armies.
s0290.idiomatic: On wuwu day an edict ordered Prince Chalithemur to command all armies.

s0291.literal: Zhao Yourui's son Menggui inherited the title Duke of Pingyuan Commandery.
s0291.idiomatic: Zhao Yourui's son Menggui inherited the title Duke of Pingyuan Commandery.

s0292.literal: Nayan sent envoys to levy Eastern Route troops; Chalithemur was instructed not to mobilize rashly.
s0292.idiomatic: Nayan sent envoys to levy Eastern Route troops; Chalithemur was instructed not to mobilize rashly.

s0293.literal: Intercalary month, guihai day: the moon transgressed Mercury.
s0293.idiomatic: Intercalary month, guihai day: the moon transgressed Mercury.

s0294.literal: Because Jurchen and Shui Dada tribes had famine year after year, grain was transferred to relieve them, and this year's public levies were fully remitted and half the fur-cloth tribute reduced.
s0294.idiomatic: Because Jurchen and Shui Dada tribes had famine year after year, grain was transferred to relieve them, and this year's public levies were fully remitted and half the fur-cloth tribute reduced.

s0295.literal: Song colonized-army officers were appointed civilian officials and dispersed to counties and prefectures.
s0295.idiomatic: Song colonized-army officers were appointed civilian officials and dispersed to counties and prefectures.

s0296.literal: An edict ordered sacrifice at Emperor Yao's shrine on bing days of the second months of spring and autumn.
s0296.idiomatic: An edict ordered sacrifice at Emperor Yao's shrine on bing days of the second months of spring and autumn.

s0297.literal: Officials managing levied horses in Xijing and elsewhere conspired, claiming each year to use surplus revenue from Xijing, Pingyang, and Taiyuan beyond quotas to buy one thousand horses and camels for the government, but actually embezzled government funds for the purchases; investigation found evidence and they were executed.
s0297.idiomatic: Officials managing levied horses in Xijing and elsewhere conspired, claiming each year to use surplus revenue from Xijing, Pingyang, and Taiyuan beyond quotas to buy 1,000 horses and camels for the government, but actually embezzled government funds for the purchases; investigation found evidence and they were executed.

s0298.literal: On yichou day the Emperor hunted in the near suburbs.
s0298.idiomatic: On yichou day the Emperor hunted in the near suburbs.

s0299.literal: Maishuding, Tiemuer, Yang Jukuan, and others were summoned together with Hanlin academician Aruqinsaili and Ye Li, Cheng Wenhai, and Zhao Mengfu to discuss paper currency.
s0299.idiomatic: Maishuding, Tiemuer, Yang Jukuan, and others were summoned together with Hanlin academician Aruqinsaili and Ye Li, Cheng Wenhai, and Zhao Mengfu to discuss paper currency.

s0300.literal: Maishuding said: "Since changing the State Revenue Bureau to the Ministry secretariat has been quite effective, it would now be better to split the two secretariats again.
s0300.idiomatic: Maishuding said, "Since changing the state revenue bureau to the ministry secretariat has been quite effective, it would now be better to split the two secretariats again.
